race.comment: PURPLE HAZE (1) resumes after eight months and brings strong placing form, including a nose defeat at Port Macquarie and a later Kembla Grange second. Trial evidence is mixed, yet his overall profile is solid. WARM FRONT (3) has not been finishing his races off, but the move back from provincial grade and added race fitness give him a clear chance to improve. REPEAT OFFENDER (9) was only beaten three and a half lengths first-up at Taree at big odds and has a minor-money profile if the rise in distance suits. EINSTEIN'S THEORY (14) strips fitter fourth-up and may be able to get involved late if the pace is genuine.
